properties.description: 9 core tests on the primes trial's shapes: Euclid's reductio with its supposition assumed and discharged (and not), the what-if past a discharged assumption, an induction step discharging its hypothesis and generalizing over k, inf:euclid generalizing over L until a premise fixes L, a computation at n = 40 that cannot carry a generalization, statement kinds and a conjecture reading open then refuted, two proofs stated independent and checked, and a definition with no budget direction that round-trips.
